workarounds.symptom: test: exit-cleanup.test.ts fails with EBUSY on rmdir on windows-2022 (flaky)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(#4896): correct multi-cycle REPL cost/turn split and closure attribution. Target files: src/agent/facets/derive.test.ts, src/agent/facets/derive.trace.test.ts, src/agent/facets/derive.trace.ts. Since #4890, a REPL session that runs `/clear` writes one root `closure` per cycle and a single `session_sealed` that carries only the last cycle. This PR fixes the six readers from the issue that assumed a single root cycle. (Ref: https://github.com/griffinwork40/agent-afk/pull/4898)
